subtitle: Start with an old PC, automate mining, and build your idle crypto empire.
heroText: Turn basic hardware into an advanced virtual mining operation. Upgrade miners, automate production, progress while offline, and prestige for permanent bonuses. Idle Crypto Tycoon is a virtual simulation game and does not mine or reward real cryptocurrency.

features.title: Offline Progress
features.description: Your operation keeps producing while you're away. Return to collect offline earnings and reinvest them in stronger miners and upgrades.

features.title: Progression & Prestige
features.description: Reset your progress when growth slows, earn Prestige Tokens, and unlock permanent bonuses that make every new run faster.

features.title: Strategic Automation
features.description: Unlock scripts to automate production. Progress from basic computers and smartphones to mining rigs, ASICs, data centers, and the Quantum Miner.

features.title: Missions & Random Events
features.description: Complete quick missions, collect delivery bonuses, face hacker attacks, and discover random events that add variety to every session.

features.title: Play Your Way
features.description: Progress through regular play, use rewarded ads to improve selected rewards, or choose optional in-app purchases to accelerate parts of your journey.

features.title: Cloud Save & Updates
features.description: Sync your progress across supported devices with Google Play Games cloud save and enjoy regular updates, improvements, and balance changes.

whyPlayItems: Visible Progression: Start with an old PC and unlock increasingly powerful miners
Idle Automation: Use scripts and upgrades to keep your operation producing
Permanent Growth: Prestige for bonuses that make every new run stronger
More Ways to Progress: Complete missions, collect deliveries, face events, and unlock skins
ctaText: Upgrade miners, automate your operation, progress while offline, and build your virtual mining empire in Idle Crypto Tycoon.
